explanation: Corollary 29 of Fradelizi–Manui–Meyer–Ndiaye: for a planar convex body K with a centre of symmetry containing the origin and p > 1, |K ⊕_p −K| ≤ (2Γ(1+1/q)²/Γ(1+2/q) + 2)|K|. The Firey sum is defined as the Wulff shape of (h_K^p + h_{−K}^p)^{1/p}. That function is sublinear for p ≥ 1 and nonnegative because 0 ∈ K, so the Wulff shape coincides with the source's body. The statement is correct and solved.
